# CATARC public HTML test fixtures

Saved on 2026-10-26 for parser regression tests. Files retain the source HTML including desktop tables and duplicate mobile cards, so tests can detect double counting. These files are test input only, never executable application assets.

- comment-detail.html: https://zxd.catarc.org.cn/zxd/portal/zqyj/935
